name: craft_inspect
description: Inspect optional Craft Gateway capabilities, project/artifact IDs, or jobs; collect completed outputs into Stash, or request cancellation. Cancelling an observer does not cancel remote work. Inspect saved job_id/request_id after disconnects instead of resubmitting. Use action jobs to find recent accepted work when an observer stopped before returning its job ID.

project_id.description: Existing gateway project for follow-up edits and Craft artifact reuse. Omit for a new project.

availability.setup_hint: Run jarvis-craft-tools/setup.sh on the app host, then set CRAFT_API_URL and CRAFT_API_KEY in the selected mode ENV. See jarvis-craft-tools/README.md.
